stance_rationale: Hard bounds are numerically satisfied, but the optimizer deliverable is still a single-date snapshot and fails walk-forward schedule requirements (RF-O9). Cost internalization, conditioning claims, and ex-post triangulation with Forge are inconsistent enough that optimizer sign-off is not defensible.

cost_audit.cost_proportionality_check: Package uses one-way TC (~0.2811*15bps=0.00042) while checklist requires round-trip (~0.00084); cost drag is understated.

critical_concerns.description: RF-O9 triggered: optimizer weights are single-snapshot (weights.csv has one as_of_date=2026-04-25), and alpha_scores.parquet also has one as_of_date, so walk-forward re-optimization is not delivered by this package.
Cost modeling is inconsistent with the role checklist: estimated_cost is computed as one-way turnover cost, not round-trip; this biases net_IR selection in a close-method regime.

Conditioning claim is internally inconsistent for optimizer usability: factor-cov cond~96.8 is cited, but the actual security covariance artifact used by optimizer is cond~500 (PSD true but far above ≤100 target).

Method selection rationale is overconfident and ex-post contradicted: optimizer projected all methods pass Harvey gate, but Forge FF5 v2 t_NW remains below gate; cherry-pick/optimism control is insufficient.
Iter-specific risk alignment is incomplete: no explicit heavy-tail (Hill alpha) tie-break evidence and no CRISIS small-sample fallback (max_w tightening/cash sleeve) despite regime caveats.
Top-alpha realization gap exists in delivered candidate set (e.g., top-decile candidate with zero weight), and justification is mostly narrative instead of explicit signal-loss control.
Sequential Admission evidence is missing (TDC vs PG2, replacement/integration scenario metrics), so admission risk versus active book cannot be validated.

supporting_arguments: Core hard bounds are satisfied in the package payload: n_names=20, max_w=0.1089, long-only, and target_weights sum to 1.0.
Method shopping log is present with candidates_tried=10 and explicit net_ir objective.
No direct hard-block violations (RF-O5/6/7/13) were found in the optimizer package fields.
unresolved_disputes: Canonical artifact paths are split (04_Research/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260425_009 vs stage_artifacts/WT-D20260425_009), while qepm/stage_artifacts path requested in task is absent for WT_009.
Optimizer package says Forge should consume current weights.csv, but Forge reports using parent WT_005 weights_rolling.parquet (92 dates); canonical schedule source is ambiguous.
Post-shrink cond threshold interpretation is inconsistent (factor-cov vs security-cov gate).
Liquidity mandate is documented at multiple thresholds (50M vs 200M), but optimizer evidence for applied threshold at selection-time is not fully explicit.
weakest_assumption: Naive net_IR scaling implies Harvey gate pass (t_NW ~4-5+) for selected weights, despite actual Forge FF5 v2 results staying far below 2.95.
rebuttal_required: Submit true walk-forward optimizer output for WT-D20260425_009 (>=60 sig_dates, as_of_date×ticker×weight×method_selected), not a single-date snapshot.
Recompute cost with round-trip turnover convention and re-rank methods on corrected net_ir.
Provide security-cov stabilization evidence meeting the declared conditioning gate (or formally revise gate definition).
Document heavy-tail and CRISIS fallback policy explicitly (Hill alpha decision rule, bound tightening, cash sleeve).
Add Sequential Admission diagnostics: TDC vs PG2, replacement vs integration metrics, and integration weight breakdown.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Optimizer package-level claims do not triangulate with Forge outcome or delivered schedule artifacts; 2-source PASS quality is not established.

optimizer_specific_questions: 현재 제출된 weights.csv(1 sig_date)만으로 WT-D20260425_009의 시계열 백테스트를 어떻게 재현할 것인가?
selection_objective가 net_ir라면 왜 비용을 round-trip이 아닌 one-way로 계산했는가?
security covariance cond~500 상태에서 MVO 수치안정성 gate를 어떤 기준으로 PASS 처리했는가?
Forge가 WT_005 rolling weights를 사용한 이유와, WT_009 optimizer 산출물의 canonical status는 무엇인가?
